note: The copy deck of the E15-D16 hand-off pack (docs/design/specs/e15-handoff.md §7): every row of the parents' copy tables (E15-D03 §9, E15-D04 §13, E15-D05 §14, E15-D06 §11, E15-D07 §9, E15-D08 §8, E15-D09 §9, E15-D10 §5.10, the multi-chart grid spec §14, the responsive spec §10) and E15-D15's script (§6.1), plus E15-D07's close line (§12.3, C-u). Each key is `<source>:<line> <the parent's row id>`; each value is the parent's String cell, verbatim, with the parent's own quotes and notes. The parent owns every string; this deck adds none. `concepts` lists the entries of each concept group the pack's consistency diff (§7.2) reads. Checked by docs/design/_tools/e15_d16_handoff_check.py (G-DECK).
